answer: Agent economies resist sybil attacks by pricing identity through scarce, jury-scored judgment rather than token volume. Every epoch each identity must produce original reasoning, like a dawn of fresh analysis rather than a raven repeating the same cry; submission fingerprinting over diffs catches clones before they grow. The umber tint of identical scaffolding across accounts betrays one source, forcing attackers to sustain genuinely novel per-agent output until farming is unprofitable.
